tools.name: crm_search_accounts
tools.description: Find CRM accounts by company name. Returns full account details, owner, renewal, annual value and support mapping; reuse these without another lookup. Multiple matches require clarification.

tools.name: crm_get_account
tools.description: Look up a known CRM customer_id when details are not already available from search. Search already returns the full account.

tools.name: crm_get_contacts
tools.description: List contacts for a known account, including primary designation and nullable email. Never infer a primary contact or missing email.

tools.name: crm_get_deals
tools.description: List account deals. OPEN excludes CLOSED_WON and CLOSED_LOST; ALL includes all stages. Amounts are in USD. Use stage explicitly.

tools.name: crm_get_contacts_batch
tools.description: List contacts for multiple known accounts in one read. Use this after a multi-account search instead of calling crm_get_contacts repeatedly. Primary designations and nullable emails retain their original meaning.

tools.name: crm_get_deals_batch
tools.description: List deals for multiple known accounts in one read. Use OPEN to exclude CLOSED_WON and CLOSED_LOST. Results retain customer_id for grouping.

tools.name: crm_list_renewals
tools.description: List accounts renewing within an inclusive date range. Use explicit YYYY-MM-DD start and end dates; does not infer risk or support status.

tools.name: support_get_open_tickets
tools.description: Get OPEN tickets using an organization_id from a CRM account's support_customer_id.

tools.name: support_get_open_tickets_batch
tools.description: Get OPEN tickets for multiple known support organizations in one read. Use CRM support_customer_id mappings and omit accounts whose mapping is empty.
